answer_verbatim:
Pleasanton has a solid mix of dedicated professional salons and high-end aesthetic centers offering UV and sunless tanning options. 

Here are the specific tanning and wellness salons in Pleasanton you should call, along with why you should reach out to each:

### 1. Palm Beach Tan (Pleasanton Location)
* **Why call them:** This is the best choice if you are looking for **variety, consistency, and flexible membership options**. As a major regional/national chain, their Pleasanton location is typically equipped with a wide range of equipment levels—from entry-level base beds to high-pressure bulbs that minimize burning and maximize golden color. They also generally offer reliable automated spray-tan booths (like VersaSpa).
* **Ask them about:** Their introductory specials (often a free week or heavily discounted first month) and what specific bed levels they currently have in stock at the Pleasanton store.

### 2. European Wax Center (Pleasanton) / Local Spas (Note on Sunless Tanning)
* *Self-Correction/Nuance:* While dedicated UV tanning salons have become less common as standalone storefronts due to health trends, many local beauty and skincare boutiques in the Hacienda business park area or downtown Pleasanton offer **custom airbrush (spray) tanning**. 
* **Why call local boutique estheticians:** If you specifically want a **hand-applied, custom spray tan** rather than an automated booth, you will get a much more natural, contoured result from a local aesthetician than a chain. Search for local mobile spray tanners or boutique skincare studios in Pleasanton.

---

### Questions to Ask When You Call:
Before booking or walking in, make sure to ask these specific questions to ensure the salon fits your needs:

1. **"Are you strictly UV tanning, or do you offer sunless (spray) options as well?"** (Knowing this saves time if you prefer one over the other).
2. **"What levels of beds do you have?"** (If you have fair skin, you’ll want to know if they have entry-level beds or low-UV high-pressure options so you don’t burn).
3. **"Do I need an appointment, or do you take walk-ins?"**
4. **"What are your current introductory specials for first-time clients?"** 

*Tip: If you are new to UV tanning, always start with a very short session (e.g., 4 to 6 minutes depending on the bed) to see how your skin reacts before building up your time.*
